# HostifyOS — The Modern Hosting OS & Automated STR Revenue Engine

> HostifyOS (https://www.hostifyos.com) is an all-in-one hospitality operating system and progressive web app (PWA) designed for short-term rental (STR) hosts, Airbnb Superhosts, Vrbo operators, and boutique hotels. It automates guest communication, eliminates repetitive check-in inquiries, and monetizes in-room guest stays with 0% platform commission upsells.

## Core Capabilities & Features

- **1-Tap Wi-Fi Password Copying**: Guests tap a single button on their smartphone to copy complex Wi-Fi passwords to their clipboard without typing errors.
- **Time-Gated Door Lockbox PIN Codes**: Smart security protocol where keyless check-in codes become visible only 2 hours prior to check-in time and automatically expire at 11:00 AM check-out.
- **In-Room Concierge & 0% Commission Upsells**: Direct host payment gateway supporting Credit Cards (Stripe/Dodo Payments), FAST/IBAN bank transfers, USDT Crypto wallets, and WhatsApp order routing with 0% platform commission on Pro and Enterprise tiers.
- **Instant AI Listing Importer**: Auto-extracts photos, room amenities, Wi-Fi details, and house rules directly from Airbnb and Booking.com listing URLs in 15 seconds.
- **Multi-Language Auto-Translation**: Native support for 8 languages (English, Turkish, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic with RTL support).
- **Printable A5 QR Stand Generator**: Generates high-resolution vector PDF room stands with embedded QR codes for nightstands and living rooms.
- **Live Regional Assistant Tools**: Integrated real-time weather (Open-Meteo), live flight tracking, local prayer times (Aladhan), multi-currency converter, and geolocated taxi/emergency services.

## Pricing & Subscription Tiers

- **Pro Host Plan ($14/month billed annually at $168/yr / $19/month billed monthly)**: 14-Day Free Trial ($0 today). Up to 10 properties, 0% commission upsell store, time-gated door PIN, custom branding, AI listing auto-importer, WhatsApp messaging tunnels, A5 Acrylic QR Stand PDF generator.
- **Enterprise & Hotel Plan ($29/month billed annually at $348/yr / $39/month billed monthly)**: 14-Day VIP Trial. Multi-unit boutique hotels & resorts, priority 24/7 phone SLA, white-label custom domain, automated team cleaning portal.
- **Secure Checkout Page**: https://www.hostifyos.com/checkout.html (Supports Credit Card, Apple Pay, Bank Wire / FAST, USDT Crypto, WhatsApp VIP)
